namespaces.name: capabilities
namespaces.description: The capability map: catalog, inventory, and overview of the whole operation surface. Returns every namespace with its operation count, drills into one namespace's operations, or ranks operations by keyword. Call before concluding an operation does not exist.

namespaces.name: invoices
namespaces.description: Sales invoices (INV/SI). Create, search, get, update, delete, pay, finalize, apply credits, download PDF. Also: receivables, AR, AR aging, billing, overdue invoices, dunning, recurring invoices. To create from an uploaded invoice file/PDF/image, use the document_ai namespace (AI extraction), not manual entry.

namespaces.name: customer_credit_notes
namespaces.description: Customer credit notes (CN). Create, search, update, delete, finalize, refund, download PDF. Also: sales returns, customer CN.

namespaces.name: bills
namespaces.description: Purchase bills (PO/PI). Create, search, get, update, delete, pay, finalize, apply credits. Also: payables, AP, vendor invoices, supplier bills. To create from an uploaded bill/invoice file/PDF/image, use the document_ai namespace (AI extraction), not manual entry.

namespaces.name: supplier_credit_notes
namespaces.description: Supplier credit notes. Create, search, update, delete, finalize, refund. Also: purchase returns, debit notes, supplier CN.

namespaces.name: sale_orders
namespaces.description: Sales order documents: Sale Quotes (estimates/quotations) and Sale Orders. Create, get, search, update, accept a quote, confirm an order, void, delete a draft. A Sale Order links to its quote via saleQuoteResourceId; the quote must be issued (not DRAFT/VOID). Tracks fulfillment via orderState. Pipeline: quote → order → invoice (convert_sale_order_to_invoice).

namespaces.name: purchase_orders
namespaces.description: Purchase order documents: Purchase Requests (requisitions) and Purchase Orders (POs). Create, get, search, update, accept a request, confirm an order, void, delete a draft. A Purchase Order links to its request via purchaseRequestResourceId; the request must be issued (not DRAFT/VOID). Tracks fulfillment via orderState. Pipeline: request → order → bill (convert_purchase_order_to_bill).

namespaces.name: journals
namespaces.description: Journal entries (JE). Create, search, update, delete manual journals. Also: adjusting entries, accruals, reclassifications, corrections, transfer trial balance (TTB).

namespaces.name: cash_entries
namespaces.description: Cash-in receipts and cash-out disbursements for external cash movements. WHEN TO USE: money received from customers/external → cash-in. Money paid to suppliers/external → cash-out. For internal account-to-account transfers, use cash_transfers namespace.

namespaces.name: cash_transfers
namespaces.description: Cash transfers between your own bank/cash accounts and cashflow transaction search. WHEN TO USE: moving funds between own accounts (main bank → petty cash, USD → SGD). For external receipts/payments, use cash_entries namespace.

namespaces.name: bank_accounts
namespaces.description: Bank accounts, bank statement imports (CSV/OFX), bank records search, auto-reconciliation. For unreconciled queries: ALWAYS search bank records with status UNRECONCILED after listing accounts. Also: bank feeds, bank balance.

namespaces.name: bank_rules
namespaces.description: Bank reconciliation rules (action shortcuts). Create, search, update, delete bank rules. Configure auto-matching rules for bank records.

namespaces.name: reconciliations
namespaces.description: Apply a reconciliation decision to a bank statement entry (write side). Match bank records to EXISTING open bills/invoices/payments (reconcile_with_payments, the primary path, creates the payment for you), or to journals, cash entries, or transfers, or CREATE new bills/invoices (invoice_receipt/bill_receipt). Distinct from bank_accounts/bank_rules (which configure auto-reconciliation) and view_auto_reconciliation (which queries suggestions). Thirteen endpoints: quick_reconcile + apply_bank_rule + magic_match (bulk), undo_reconciliations (bulk reverse), and direct_cash_entry / cash_journal / manual_journal / cash_transfer / invoice_receipt / bill_receipt / with_payments / learned_prediction / unapplied_payment (per-entry). Match-to-existing is preferred over create-new to avoid duplicates. Most fields prefill from the bank entry when omitted; FX is resolved server-side. To reverse a reconciliation use undo_reconciliations, which unlinks the entry but does NOT delete a record a reconcile call created; it returns linkedRecords so you can delete that record too.

namespaces.name: financial_reports
namespaces.description: Core financial statements: trial balance (TB), balance sheet (BS/B/S), profit & loss (PnL/P&L/income statement), cash flow, general ledger (GL), cash balance/position, equity movement, VAT/GST ledger. Also: how profitable, what is the balance. XLSX/PDF file exports of any of these statements are produced via download_export (lives in operational_reports namespace; switch there or call by name).

namespaces.name: report_templates
namespaces.description: Report templates: the saved layout of a report (title, fonts, rows, columns, period) and report packs (several reports in one document). List, read, search, create, edit, set the default, delete. Customize or rename a P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, GL, GST/VAT ledger or aging layout; change which template a report uses by default. Render a template with download_export.

namespaces.name: operational_reports
namespaces.description: Aging and operational reports: aged receivables (AR aging), aged payables (AP aging), AR report, bank balance summary, bank reconciliation reports. Data exports (CSV/Excel/XLSX). Anomaly detection and audit analysis: anomalous invoices, anomalous bills, cashflow anomalies, GL journal audit, exchange rate audit, receivables customer risk, cash expense health. Also: overdue analysis, how much owed, suspicious transactions, audit trail, ledger highlights. Fixed asset register reports are in register_reports.

namespaces.name: register_reports
namespaces.description: Register reports: fixed asset register summary by account, type, category or active/closed-out/disposed state (asset register roll-forward over a period), fixed asset register vs general ledger reconciliation (does the register agree with the GL), deferrals summary (prepaid and deferred revenue roll-forward) and deferrals reconciliation (does the prepaid register agree with the GL), lease register summary (IFRS 16 lease note, lease liability roll-forward) and lease register vs general ledger reconciliation (rent coded to the lease liability account). Loan reports: borrowings note summary, loan roll-forward, related-party (director, shareholder) loan balances, loan interest cost, maturity analysis (liquidity note), loan register vs ledger reconciliation.

namespaces.name: pseudo_sql
namespaces.description: Pseudo-SQL ad-hoc read-only queries against the curated reporting schema (custom select, custom report, query data, run sql). Includes live schema introspection (get_pseudo_sql_schema), sync preview (≤100 rows) and polling a CSV export (get_pseudo_sql_export). Use when search_* / download_export canonical reports don't cover the question. To export a query as CSV, use pseudo_sql_exports.

namespaces.name: pseudo_sql_exports
namespaces.description: Export a pseudo-SQL query result as a CSV file: start an async export (then poll get_pseudo_sql_export in pseudo_sql), or run and download in one call. Write and preview the query with pseudo_sql first.

namespaces.name: contacts
namespaces.description: Contacts (customers/suppliers/vendors), contact groups, customer segmentation. Create, search, get, update, delete contacts. Contact signals: usual values and billing rhythm. Bulk upsert contacts from CSV / spreadsheet imports: async, returns jobId, poll background_jobs. List/create contact groups.

namespaces.name: items_and_inventory
namespaces.description: Products, services, inventory items. Create, search, get, update, delete items. Check inventory balance. List/search purchase-side catalog items. Also: SKU, catalog, stock.

namespaces.name: catalogs
namespaces.description: Catalogs: named groupings of products/services, optionally scoped to contact groups. Create, search, get, update, delete catalogs.

namespaces.name: tags_and_custom_fields
namespaces.description: Tags for categorizing transactions. Custom fields for adding metadata (text, date, dropdown). Create, search, delete tags and custom fields.

namespaces.name: tracking_categories
namespaces.description: Tracking categories (nano classifiers; dimensions). List, search, create, update, delete classifiers and their classes. Used for line-item tagging and dimensional reporting. Also: tracking categories, cost centers, departments, projects.

namespaces.name: chart_of_accounts
namespaces.description: Chart of accounts (COA/GL accounts). Create, search, update accounts, including setting or removing an account's period lock date (lock / unlock a period, lock date: block recording or editing transactions on the account dated on or before a date). Bookmarks (favorites/shortcuts). Also: ledger codes, account types.

namespaces.name: currencies
namespaces.description: Currencies, exchange rates (FX/forex). List/add org currencies. Set, update, import currency rates. Also: multi-currency, FX rates.

namespaces.name: tax_profiles
namespaces.description: Tax profiles (GST/VAT/sales tax), withholding tax codes (WHT/ATC). Search, create, update tax profiles. List WHT codes. Search tax return filings (BIR, GST F5).

namespaces.name: claim_settings
namespaces.description: Employee-expense claim configuration (Settings -> Claim Settings): claim types (expense categories) and claim profiles (per-employee policy: approver, limits, visible types, balance account). Full CRUD + search on each.

namespaces.name: posting_rules
namespaces.description: Claim posting rules: how approved employee-expense claims group into journals at conversion (outer/inner grouping axes, line templates, default reimbursement bank). Full CRUD + search.

namespaces.name: claims
namespaces.description: Employee-expense claims (the Claims area / Employees). Search, get, update DRAFT claims (line items, employee, vendor), and drive the lifecycle: submit, approve, reject, cancel, unpost (reverse conversion), delete. Status flow DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED → CONVERTED ("Processed"), or REJECTED / CANCELLED. Claims are born via create_claim, document attachment or conversion; the server enforces legal transitions.

namespaces.name: claim_processing
namespaces.description: Process employee-expense claims: convert APPROVED claims into journal entries (preview + commit, books-only, no real-money disburse), record books-only employee payouts (reimbursements / advances) and search them, run bulk claim actions (submit / approve / reject / cancel / delete many at once; asynchronous, returns a background-job handle to poll), plus the claim tracking-tag and custom-field-value pickers.

namespaces.name: employees
namespaces.description: Employees (expense-claim members): create, update, get, delete, and search employees; search the employee-balance directory (reimbursement balances owed); link or unlink a login user; and bulk-import employees from a sheet (preprocess preview → async import). Archive an employee with update active=false rather than deleting.

namespaces.name: transaction_groups
namespaces.description: Transaction groups (capsules): group related transactions (a loan and its repayments, a prepaid bill and its amortization journals). Create, get, update, delete, search capsules; list and create capsule types; move transactions between capsules.

namespaces.name: calculators
namespaces.description: Offline financial calculators: amortization, depreciation, deferred revenue, prepaid amortization, IFRS 16 leases, hire purchase, fixed deposits, FX revaluation, loan schedules, ECL/expected credit loss, IAS 37 provisions, asset disposal, accruals, leave accrual, dividends. Returns the schedule and journal lines; posts nothing. For what-if questions and topics with no register; to keep a lease, loan, prepaid or deferred revenue use its register. Keywords: calculate, what-if, monthly payment, provision, schedule, expected credit loss, revaluation, amortize, recipe, prepaid-expense, accrued-expense.

namespaces.name: scheduled_transactions
namespaces.description: Scheduled/recurring invoices, bills, journals. Create scheduled invoices/bills/journals, search scheduled transactions. Also: recurring, auto-generate, set up to repeat every month.

namespaces.name: subscriptions
namespaces.description: Subscriptions (recurring billing/payment plans). Create, update, cancel, search subscriptions. Also: recurring charges, subscription schedules.

namespaces.name: organization
namespaces.description: Organization info (name, currency, country, fiscal year). User management: invite, update, remove, search org users. Bulk invite. List enabled modules (org features/capabilities). Agent context bundle. Next document reference number (numbering series) for invoices, bills, credit notes, quotes, orders and journals.

namespaces.name: document_ai
namespaces.description: File attachments, spreadsheets, and document AI. Read and parse rows from attached spreadsheets: CSV, Excel, XLSX. Scan a single invoice / bill / receipt PDF or image to create a draft bill, invoice, or expense claim via AI extraction (create_transaction_from_document, with the file or a sourceUrl). Auto-sort a whole FOLDER, a .zip, or a Dropbox / Google Drive / OneDrive folder share link of mixed paperwork ("create docs from this Dropbox folder link", a pile/batch of invoices and bills) into invoices, bills, credit notes, and bank statements with classify_documents, then create the drafts with extract_documents. Upload and list attachments; track extraction workflows.

namespaces.name: fixed_assets
namespaces.description: Fixed assets (PP&E/property, plant, equipment). Search, create, update (one or bulk), discard, sell, transfer, undo disposal, close out (stop depreciating, keep the asset) and reopen. Also: depreciation, asset register. Depreciation schedules, totals, eligible bill lines and asset types are in fixed_asset_schedules.

namespaces.name: fixed_asset_schedules
namespaces.description: Read-only fixed asset views. Show one asset's depreciation by month and year, net book value, asset register totals as at a date, disposal totals (gain/loss), eligible bill lines to register as assets, asset types. Check custom depreciation ranges; calculate disposal (accumulated depreciation, net book value) before selling or discarding.

namespaces.name: deferrals
namespaces.description: Deferrals register: prepaid expense, prepayment, deferred revenue, unearned revenue. Spread a bill over months, recognise an invoice over months (amortization, release schedule). Search, create, update, delete, stop amortising early (close out) and undo it, totals as at a date, schedule, eligible bill or invoice lines, deferral types and deferral accounts (mark the accounts first), bulk create and update.

namespaces.name: leases
namespaces.description: Leases under IFRS 16: put an office rent lease on the books (right-of-use asset, ROU, and lease liability, current and non-current), hire purchase (flat rate to monthly discount rate), short-term or low-value exemption. Search, create, update, delete, close out, terminate lease (preview the gain or loss first) and undo either; lease schedule, liability totals as at a date, rent schedule preview, lease types.

namespaces.name: loans
namespaces.description: Loans and borrowings register: record a new bank loan, loan, borrowing, bank loan, term loan, director's loan (revolving credit and loans given are not in the register), instalment / installment loan. Search, create, update (one or bulk), delete, close out. What do we owe a lender or the bank: outstanding principal, current and non-current at a date, the repayment schedule, an on-demand loan ledger (an on-demand loan has no schedule, is all current and posts no interest), loan types, preview the monthly payment. Loan changes (drawdown, prepay, rate change, settle) are in loan_events; loan reports are in register_reports.

namespaces.name: loan_events
namespaces.description: Events on an existing loan: drawdown, prepay or extra repayment, rate change, payment holiday, capitalize interest, restructure, refinance, settle / payoff, forgive / write off a loan, convert loan to shares, covenant breach (reclassify as current), undo loan event, balance after a missed payment. preview: true calculates the figures and saves nothing.

namespaces.name: payments_and_search
namespaces.description: Payment records: get, update, delete individual payments. List payments/credits on invoices and bills. Reverse credit applications. Record a withholding tax certificate from a customer (BIR Form 2307, CWT). Cashflow transaction search. Universal cross-entity search. Also: payment run, batch payment, payment matching, void payment, payment history, credit note applications, transaction summary.

namespaces.name: unapplied_payments
namespaces.description: Cash received or paid before it is applied to invoices or bills: record (or draft and finalize), search, apply to documents, attach existing payments, remove an application, edit, delete. Also: unallocated receipts, customer deposits, advances, prepayments, payments on account. To record one straight from a bank record, use reconcile_unapplied_payment in reconciliations.

namespaces.name: versions
namespaces.description: Document version history and restore. List the versions held for a journal, bill, invoice or credit note, read one snapshot, or restore the document to it. Restoring replaces current state.

namespaces.name: approvals
namespaces.description: Approve invoices, bills and credit notes awaiting approval, or send documents back for changes (also orders, quotes, requests, claims). Approving posts the ledger and is one-shot. Find what is waiting with the approvalStatus filter on the relevant search tool.

namespaces.name: quick_fix
namespaces.description: Quick Fix: bulk-update or set fields on transactions or line items in one call, on bills, cash entries, customer credit notes, invoices, journal schedules, journals, purchase schedules, sale schedules, subscription schedules, supplier credit notes, purchase orders, purchase requests, sale orders, sale quotes. On a record: capsule, contact, currency and exchange rate, custom fields, due date, tags, tax currency, account, reference, billing address, billing and shipping address, template, end date, internal notes, repeat interval. On lines: tracking classes, discount, item, line name, account, quantity, tax profile, unit price, withholding tax, amount, description, SKU. Ledger Find & Fix: preview one change to records found by filter across those types, run it once the user confirms. Also: batch update, mass edit, find & fix, find and fix, find & recode, find and recode, recode, reclassify, bulk edit, change all, move these to account, retag, re-date, change the contact on all, fix the account on every.

namespaces.name: export_records
namespaces.description: Export records to XLSX. List available columns, preview export scope (row count + sample), generate export file with pre-signed download URL. Supports any entity type: invoices, bills, contacts, items, journals, bank records, cashflow, fixed assets, etc. Pass query (structured search syntax) or filter (JSON), never both.

namespaces.name: background_jobs
namespaces.description: Background job tracking. Poll any async operation by jobId (contacts bulk-upsert, items bulk-upsert, bank import, magic file processing, etc.). Filter by resourceId field to look up a specific job. Poll until status is SUCCESS, FAILED, or PARTIAL_SUCCESS.

namespaces.name: drafts
namespaces.description: Draft business transactions: both local payload validation (invoices, bills, journals, credit notes) AND BULK-FRIENDLY server-side lifecycle: validate_drafts (sync eligibility check), convert_drafts_to_active (async promote to ACTIVE), submit_drafts_for_approval (async route to approval). The lifecycle tools are GENERIC and BULK: one call accepts up to 500 items mixing any combination of {btResourceId, btType: SALE|PURCHASE|SALE_CREDIT_NOTE|PURCHASE_CREDIT_NOTE}. No need for per-entity tools when promoting/submitting drafts at scale. NOT idempotent on already-promoted drafts.

namespaces.name: collab
namespaces.description: Comment threads on bills, invoices, credit notes and bank records: list threads and comments, add a reply or start a thread, mention a teammate, update or delete your own comment, resolve a thread. Notifications: list unread mentions and comments, mark one read or unread, mark all read.

namespaces.name: help_center
namespaces.description: Search the Jaz help center for how-to articles, feature guides, accounting concepts, and troubleshooting. Returns top matches with title, section, snippet, and source URL. Works without an API key.

namespaces.name: jots
namespaces.description: The judgment journal. jot records a judgment call (chose among real alternatives and wrote, or deliberately held a write); recall looks up prior judgments and precedents by entity, kind, or freetext. Tier: CRITICAL only for money-out, delete, finalize, or a recovery that re-drove a write; a withheld write is HIGH. Also: decision log, rationale, why.

namespaces.name: navigation
namespaces.description: Dashboard navigation deep links. Build a URL to any dashboard screen or record for the user, including the view link for a record just created or updated (a reply reporting on a record carries its link, and dashboard URLs always come from this tool, never written from memory). Also: open, go to, take me to, link, deep link, share a link, url, navigate, show me the page/screen, where can I see (for invoices, bills, reports, settings, or a specific transaction).

tools.name: get_next_reference
tools.description: Next document number in the org's own series. Same number the web app prefills. Reading does NOT reserve it; two callers reading at once get the same value. Date embedded is always today. Never invent a reference; use this.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get organization details: name, base currency, country, and financial year end.

tools.name: get_my_context
tools.description: Resolve the CALLER's own context: identity, the employee bound to their login (if any), and per-module access (moduleRoles). Use to route a receipt (bill if PURCHASES access, expense claim if EMPLOYEE_CLAIMS access). A service api-key usually has no bound employee. Magic claim drafts auto-bind the uploader server-side; no need to read employee.resourceId to bind one.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List chart of accounts. Returns account name, code, type, class, status. Paginated; response includes totalElements. Use limit/offset to page.

tools.name: search_accounts
tools.description: Search chart of accounts. For OR (name or code), use filter: {"or":{"name":{"contains":"X"},"code":{"contains":"X"}}}.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a new chart of accounts entry. Auto-checks for duplicates by name; returns existing account if found. Code must be unique. Account class is inferred from accountType. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update a chart of accounts entry: rename, re-code, set its period lock date, or remove an existing lock date. Setting lockDate (YYYY-MM-DD) is how an individual ledger account is locked for a period: it blocks recording or editing any transaction on that account dated on or before the lock date. Pass clearLockDate to remove (unlock) an existing lock. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: bulk_upsert_chart_of_accounts
tools.description: Bulk create/update CoA entries (max 500). SYNC: returns { resourceIds, failedRows: [{rowIndex, columnName, columnValue, errorCode, errorMessage}], failedCount }; no jobId polling. PARTIAL_SUCCESS: failed rows surface in failedRows[]; others still succeed.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers/suppliers). Returns billingName, name, emails, status. Paginated; response includes totalElements. Use limit/offset to page.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Fetch a contact by internal resourceId. To search by other fields, use `search_contacts`.

tools.name: get_contact_signals
tools.description: A contact's usual values for one transaction type, from its recent posted transactions (last 12 months, up to 50): currency, payment terms, tax, account and item, each with counts. Also returns its open balance (all dates and currencies, in the base currency, up to 12h behind payments) and, only for a contact that transacts regularly, its billing rhythm (median interval, last and next expected date). USE THIS before drafting ("what does this supplier normally look like?"). To check a specific draft against this history use validate_drafts.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact. Auto-checks for duplicates by name; returns existing contact if found instead of creating a duplicate. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update an existing contact. Fetches current data first so you only need to send changed fields. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices. Returns reference, date, status, contact, totalAmount. Paginated; response includes totalElements. Use limit/offset to page.

tools.name: search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices. Supports comma-separated status (e.g., "UNPAID,PARTIALLY_PAID"). Use filter param for advanced queries (nested paths, OR groups).

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch an invoice by internal resourceId. To search by other fields, use `search_invoices`.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create invoice. lineItem text field = `name` (not "description"). saveAsDraft defaults true; false only on "finalize".

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Update an existing draft invoice (change reference, dates, line items, notes, custom fields). Line items CAN be fully replaced; pass the complete updated lineItems array. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_invoice
tools.description: Deletes a DRAFT invoice; VOIDs an active one and KEEPS it. force: true hard-deletes either. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description: Record a payment against an invoice. Invoice must be UNPAID/PARTIALLY_PAID before payment; draft or voided invoices cannot be paid. If the invoice is still a DRAFT, call finalize_invoice first. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: finalize_invoice
tools.description: Finalize a draft invoice (set saveAsDraft=false). Can optionally update fields in the same call. IMPORTANT: Every lineItem MUST have accountResourceId. If the draft was created without it, pass lineItems with accountResourceId added (search accounts first, e.g. Operating Revenue for sales). If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: apply_credits_to_invoice
tools.description: Apply customer credit note(s) to an invoice. You MUST call this tool to actually apply credits; do not just describe the steps.

tools.name: download_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Download an invoice as PDF. Returns { fileUrl } (may be pending/empty if the document is not yet rendered).

tools.name: list_bills
tools.description: List bills (purchase invoices). Returns reference, date, status, contact, amounts. Paginated; response includes totalElements. Use limit/offset to page.

tools.name: search_bills
tools.description: Search bills. Supports comma-separated status (e.g., "UNPAID,PARTIALLY_PAID"). Use filter param for advanced queries.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: Fetch a bill by internal resourceId. To search by other fields, use `search_bills`.

tools.name: create_bill
tools.description: Create a new bill. Same rules as create_invoice: name not description, saveAsDraft defaults true, accountResourceId REQUIRED on lineItems for finalized bills (search accounts first, e.g. Operating Expense). When selecting a tax profile, use search_tax_profiles with appliesTo "purchase"; sales-only profiles cause 422. reference MUST be unique; use the SUPPLIER'S OWN invoice number. If the document genuinely has none, set autoReference:true for the org's next number. Never invent one. A duplicate guard (supplier + date + currency + amount) returns `_guard: duplicate_suspected` with the existing bill instead of creating; show it, retry with allowDuplicate only once the user confirms it is separate. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: update_bill
tools.description: Update an existing draft bill (change reference, dates, line items, notes, custom fields). Line items CAN be fully replaced; pass the complete updated lineItems array. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_bill
tools.description: Deletes a DRAFT bill; VOIDs an active one and KEEPS it. force: true hard-deletes either. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: download_bill_pdf
tools.description: Download a bill as PDF. Returns { fileUrl } (may be pending/empty if the document is not yet rendered).

tools.name: pay_bill
tools.description: Record a payment against a bill. Bill must be UNPAID/PARTIALLY_PAID before payment; draft or voided bills cannot be paid. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: finalize_bill
tools.description: Finalize a draft bill (set saveAsDraft=false). Can optionally update fields in the same call. IMPORTANT: Every lineItem MUST have accountResourceId. If the draft was created without it, pass lineItems with accountResourceId added (search accounts first, e.g. Operating Expense for purchases). If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: apply_credits_to_bill
tools.description: Apply supplier credit note(s) to a bill. IMPORTANT: The credit note must be FINALIZED first (status UNAPPLIED, not DRAFT). If it is still a draft, call finalize_supplier_credit_note first. Then search_supplier_credit_notes with status UNAPPLIED to find available credits for the contact, and pass creditNoteResourceId and amountApplied for each. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: create_sale_order
tools.description: Create a Sale Quote or Sale Order (pick via documentType). lineItem text field = `name`. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. `reference` unique per org; set autoReference:true for the org's next number.

tools.name: get_sale_order
tools.description: Fetch a Sale Quote or Sale Order by internal resourceId. To search by other fields, use `search_sale_orders`.

tools.name: search_sale_orders
tools.description: Search Sale Quotes or Sale Orders (by documentType). Filter by status, contact, date, amount, currency, tag. Use the filter param for advanced/nested queries.

tools.name: update_sale_order
tools.description: Update an editable Sale Quote or Sale Order (reference, dates, notes, custom fields, lines), or issue a DRAFT quote / activate a PENDING order. lineItems EDITS stored lines by resourceId, never replaces them: get_sale_order first. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: accept_sale_quote
tools.description: Accept an issued Sale Quote (CREATED → ACCEPTED). A DRAFT can't be accepted: issue it first with update_sale_order isDraftToActiveSaleQuote:true. An issued Sale Quote can already be linked, so accepting is optional. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: confirm_sale_order

tools.name: create_transaction_from_document
tools.description: Create a business transaction (invoice/bill/credit note/quote/order/purchase request) from a SINGLE file (max 10 MB), a URL, or raw HTML (e.g. an email body) using AI extraction. Processing is async: the result is a workflow id, not the record. If the result says it runs in the background, do not poll: its result arrives by itself. Quotes/orders land DRAFT/PENDING: relay the result `next`. When the host conversation provides a file with the call, omit all source arguments; the file is used automatically. For a FOLDER, a .zip, a Dropbox/Drive/OneDrive folder share link, or several/mixed documents at once, use classify_documents (then extract_documents) instead, not this per-file. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_magic_workflow_status
tools.description: Get the current status of specific magic workflow(s) by resourceId(s). Returns workflow details including status, document type, and results.

tools.name: wait_for_magic_workflows
tools.description: Poll magic extraction workflow(s) until each reaches a terminal state (transaction created (a draft is ready), OCR succeeded/failed, or errored) or until the wait budget elapses. Use after create_transaction_from_document / extract_documents to know when drafts are ready; a workflow whose result said it runs in the background answers with that note instead. Returns each workflow's current status plus the still-pending ids; if any are still pending after the budget, call again to keep waiting. Batched into one request per poll.

tools.name: create_claim_from_attachment
tools.description: Create an employee-expense claim DRAFT from a receipt via AI extraction: from a SINGLE file, a URL (sourceURL), or raw HTML (e.g. an email body). When the host conversation provides a file with the call, omit all source arguments; the file is used automatically. On the email channel, pass attachmentId "email-body" to use the inbound email body. The draft is born BOUND to the uploader's own employee automatically; to file for someone else pass employeeResourceId (server requires a claims Manager/Admin). Optional contact, claim profile, currency, value date. Returns a workflow handle; the claim appears in Drafts asynchronously (no manual bind step). If the result says it runs in the background, do not poll: its result arrives by itself. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: classify_documents
tools.description: Use this when the user points at a FOLDER, a .zip, a Dropbox / Google Drive / OneDrive folder share link, or a pile/batch of mixed documents. Sort a ZIP or share link of MIXED accounting documents: classifies each file into invoice / bill / customer credit note / supplier credit note / quote / order / purchase request / bank statement by its FOLDER NAME within the source (e.g. files under an "invoices/" folder become invoices), WITHOUT creating anything. Returns a manifest (per-file type + confidence + counts) plus a collectionId. If nothing is extractable it returns `hint` (why + what to do) and `summary.skippedExtensions`: relay it, do NOT call extract_documents; review it, then call extract_documents with that collectionId to create the drafts. The source is FETCHED BY THE JAZ SERVER: a direct .zip/file link, or a Dropbox / Google Drive / OneDrive share link. A local path works only when this tool runs on your own machine.

tools.name: extract_documents
tools.description: Create draft transactions from a classified document collection (see classify_documents). Uploads each file to the right AI-extraction endpoint (invoices/bills/credit notes via business-transaction extraction, bank statements via statement import), de-duplicates identical files, and returns the workflow ids (wait_for_magic_workflows reads them). Processing is async; drafts appear once the workflows reach a terminal state. If the result says it runs in the background, do not poll: its result arrives by itself. Pass the collectionId from classify_documents. Returns `whereToSee[]`: the screen each landed type appears on + its uploaded/failed split (+ `next` for quotes/orders): relay those links (no `navigate`) and, unless the result says it runs in the background, say drafts are still arriving. An unbuildable link is omitted, named in `partialFailures`. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_attachments
tools.description: Get attachments for a business transaction (invoice, bill, journal, credit note, or order document).

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Add an attachment to a business transaction. Provide EXACTLY ONE source: sourceUrl (downloaded here, uploaded as bytes), attachmentId (links existing), or a file attached to the call. Two is refused. Order documents (sale-quotes, sale-orders, purchase-requests, purchase-orders) support file/sourceUrl upload ONLY; attachmentId link-by-id is rejected for them. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment from a business transaction (invoice, bill, journal, credit note, or order document). If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: read_spreadsheet_rows
tools.description: Parse rows from a CSV/Excel URL. Returns rows as JSON objects keyed by header (max 500/call, paginatable via offset/limit). Excel response includes availableSheets[]; re-call with sheetIndex if the first sheet is Instructions. Use BEFORE bulk_upsert_* when the user attaches a tabular file.

tools.name: list_comment_threads
tools.description: List the comment threads on a bill, invoice, supplier credit note, customer credit note or bank record. A record has at most one open thread. Each thread returns its newest commentLimit comments, oldest first: 5 by default, 0 for counts only. commentsTruncated says when older ones exist; read them with list_comments. Times (createdAt, updatedAt, resolvedAt) are epoch milliseconds in UTC. Bank records need bankAccountResourceId.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Read the comments of one thread on a record, newest first, a page at a time. Use it for comments older than the ones list_comment_threads returned. Times (createdAt, updatedAt) are epoch milliseconds in UTC. Bank records need bankAccountResourceId.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a bill, invoice, supplier credit note, customer credit note or bank record. The caller is the author. A record has one open thread: without threadId the comment joins it or starts one, and a resolved thread accepts none. To mention someone, write <@userResourceId> in content where the name belongs, with the userResourceId from search_org_users (not the org-user record id); the saved text fills in the name. Only members whose own status is ACTIVE can be mentioned (the row's top-level status from search_org_users, not user.status; an invited member who has not joined is PENDING and cannot), at most 20: any other id refuses the whole comment. A plain @Name is just text and notifies no one. Bank records need bankAccountResourceId.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Edit a comment the caller wrote, replacing its whole text. Only the author can, and only while its thread is open: a resolved thread refuses changes. Mentions work as in add_comment: write <@userResourceId> to add one, and keep the <Name@userResourceId> markup from content (text shows only @Name) for each mention to keep; leaving it out removes the mention. Bank records need bankAccountResourceId.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment the caller wrote. Only the author can, and only while its thread is open: a resolved thread refuses changes. Bank records need bankAccountResourceId.

tools.name: mark_thread_resolved
tools.description: Resolve a comment thread on a record. A resolved thread accepts no new comments: the next comment without threadId starts a new thread. Bank records need bankAccountResourceId.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Notifications addressed to the caller: comments and mentions on records, newest first, unread by default. The Jaz API reads the newest 500 items of the last 365 days; truncated says when older ones exist. Each item names its record and threadId. Times (createdAt, readAt) are epoch milliseconds in UTC.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark one notification read, or unread with read set to false.

tools.name: mark_all_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark every unread notification of the caller read. Returns marked and more: when more is true, call again.

tools.name: validate_invoice_draft
tools.description: Check if an invoice draft is ready to finalize. Returns missing fields, structured validation report, and ready status. Use before finalize_invoice to prevent errors.

tools.name: validate_bill_draft
tools.description: Check if a bill draft is ready to finalize. Returns missing fields, structured validation report, and ready status. Use before finalize_bill to prevent errors.

tools.name: validate_journal_draft
tools.description: Check if a journal draft is ready to finalize. Returns missing fields (accounts, amounts, date), structured validation, and ready status.

tools.name: validate_credit_note_draft
tools.description: Check if a credit note draft (customer or supplier) is ready to finalize. Returns missing fields, structured validation, and ready status.

tools.name: list_bank_rules
tools.description: List bank reconciliation rules (action shortcuts). Shows rule name, action type, and target bank account.

tools.name: get_bank_rule
tools.description: Get full bank rule details including configuration (allocation percentages, accounts, tax settings).

tools.name: search_bank_rules
tools.description: Search bank rules.

tools.name: create_bank_rule
tools.description: Bank reconciliation rule: auto-matches bank records. Use directly on request; don't just list existing.

tools.name: update_bank_rule
tools.description: Update an existing bank reconciliation rule. FULL REPLACEMENT: the API replaces the entire rule on update. You MUST provide the complete configuration, appliesToReconciliationAccount, and name every time. Use get_bank_rule first to read the current state, merge your changes, then call this tool with the full payload. searchFilter is the ONE exception: omit keeps it, null removes it. Dynamic strings: {{bankReference}}, {{bankPayee}}, {{bankDescription}}. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_bank_rule
tools.description: Delete a bank reconciliation rule. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: view_auto_reconciliation
tools.description: Generate auto-reconciliation suggestions for specific bank statement entries (no account-wide mode). READ-ONLY; does NOT write. Returns execution-ready `suggestions[]`: each carries `recommendedTool` (the commit tool to call), `execute` (ready-to-pass args; merge bankAccountResourceId for reconcile_magic_match), `confidenceTier` (high/medium/low), and `autoCommitEligible` (true ⇒ safe to commit without review). Drive the flow: for each suggestion, if `autoCommitEligible` call its `recommendedTool` with `execute`; otherwise surface for confirmation; pass `includeReviewDetails:true` to also get `review[]` (the not-auto lines enriched with the bank line + the matched bill/invoice) for a side-by-side "does this match?" card. Pass `includeRaw:true` to also get the unmapped payload. Cost tracks entries passed; batch large backlogs. On a 500 or timeout it returns `{degraded:true}`; recover via the `clio jobs bank-recon match` cascade matcher. A line whose bank line could not be read omits `bankLine`; the reason is in `partialFailures`. Read it before concluding a line has none.

tools.name: list_fixed_assets
tools.description: List fixed assets. Returns name, reference, type, category, status, purchase amount, net book value.

tools.name: get_fixed_asset
tools.description: Get full fixed asset details including depreciation schedule, accounts, disposal info.

tools.name: search_fixed_assets
tools.description: Search fixed assets.

tools.name: create_fixed_asset
tools.description: Register a fixed asset from ONE purchase line item of an existing bill or journal (each line is its own asset); several: bulk_upsert_fixed_assets. saveAsDraft defaults to true; false activates (Admin only) and needs reference, typeCode, category, depreciationMethod, effectiveLife, depreciationStartDate, the accounts, and the purchase line's type and id (the LINE ITEM, not the document id). With no linked transaction, use transfer_fixed_asset. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: update_fixed_asset
tools.description: Update one fixed asset (draft or active); 2 or more: one bulk_update_fixed_assets call. Send only what changes; omitted fields are preserved. isDraftToActive: true activates a draft. Activating or editing an active asset: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_fixed_asset
tools.description: Delete a DRAFT fixed asset, unlinking its purchase line. Any other status is not deleted by the agent: the user does it in Jaz. Prefer undo_fixed_asset_disposal or close_out_fixed_asset. Confirm first: say what it changes and wait for a yes. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: discard_fixed_asset
tools.description: Discard (write off) a fixed asset. Records the disposal and final depreciation itself: do not also post a manual disposal journal. Run calculate_fixed_asset_disposal first for the figures. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: mark_fixed_asset_sold
tools.description: Mark a fixed asset as sold. Links to the sale transaction and records the disposal and gain/loss itself: do not also post a manual disposal journal. To sell an asset, find its resourceId with search_fixed_assets, then use this tool directly. Run calculate_fixed_asset_disposal first to show the gain or loss. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: transfer_fixed_asset
tools.description: Register an asset bought before using Jaz, imported from a legacy system or purchased outside it, with the depreciation already incurred (bookValueAccumulatedDepreciationAmount); several: bulk_upsert_fixed_assets. No linked bill or journal is needed, unlike create_fixed_asset; the other fields are the same. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: undo_fixed_asset_disposal
tools.description: Undo a fixed asset disposal (discard or sale). Restores the asset to active status. When the user asks to reverse or undo a disposal, use this tool directly. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: close_out_fixed_asset
tools.description: Close out a fixed asset: depreciation stops from the month-end of closeOutDate, the asset stays on the register, nothing is reversed and no gain or loss is posted. Needs ACTIVE and not NO_DEPRECIATION. Reverse with reopen_fixed_asset. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: reopen_fixed_asset
tools.description: Reopen a CLOSED_OUT fixed asset: the full depreciation schedule is posted again and it returns to ACTIVE. Reopen before selling or discarding it. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_lease
tools.description: Get one lease with its figures as at today: lease liability, right-of-use asset, current and non-current portion, accounts, status.

tools.name: search_leases
tools.description: Search leases with liability and right-of-use figures as at endDate (default today). viewStatus picks the register tab. A terminated lease shows its figures at termination. No query: use the filters.

tools.name: create_lease
tools.description: Put a lease on the books (IFRS 16), or register a hire purchase (typeCode HIRE_PURCHASE).

tools.name: update_lease
tools.description: Edit or activate one lease (isDraftToActive: true); 2 or more: one bulk_update_leases call. Partial: send only what changes; reference defaults to the stored one.

tools.name: delete_lease
tools.description: Delete a DRAFT lease, freeing its reference. Any other status is not deleted by the agent: the user does it in Jaz. Confirm first: say what it changes and wait for a yes. To end a live lease early use terminate_lease, which keeps history. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: close_out_lease
tools.description: Stop a lease posting after the month-end of closeOutDate. NOT an exit: the liability and right-of-use asset stay on the books; to take a lease off use terminate_lease. ACTIVE right-of-use leases only. Reverse with reopen_lease. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: reopen_lease
tools.description: Reopen a CLOSED_OUT lease: the later entries are posted again and it returns to ACTIVE. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: calculate_lease_termination
tools.description: Preview terminate_lease: the lease liability and right-of-use net book value that would come off the books at the month-end of terminationDate, and the gain or loss (positive = gain). Saves nothing.

tools.name: terminate_lease
tools.description: Take an ACTIVE lease off the books at the month-end of terminationDate (keys handed back, hire purchase settled early): later entries are removed and a termination entry posts with the gain or loss.

tools.name: undo_lease_termination
tools.description: Undo a termination: the termination entry is deleted, later entries are rebuilt and the lease returns to ACTIVE. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_lease_totals
tools.description: Lease balance sheet totals as at a date: right-of-use net book value, lease liability, current and non-current portion. Excludes the restoration provision, drafts, exempt, terminated and ended leases. Figures are the schedule's, not the ledger's: use generate_leases_reconciliation_summary for the GL gap.

tools.name: get_lease_schedule
tools.description: One lease's schedule by month and by year: payment, interest, principal, liability, current portion, depreciation, net book value. Empty for drafts and exempt leases. At most 60 months per call (totalPeriods): pass fromPeriod/toPeriod for the months asked about.

tools.name: search_lease_types
tools.description: Search lease types. typeCode (OFFICE, VEHICLE, HIRE_PURCHASE and others) is what create_lease takes. No natural-language query.

tools.name: preview_lease_rent_schedule
tools.description: Check rent ranges against the term before saving: status COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE with the first broken rule, total rent and a timeline. Saves nothing; the liability needs a saved draft lease. At most 60 periods per call: see totalPeriods, page with fromPeriod/toPeriod.

tools.name: calculate_lease_flat_rate
tools.description: Hire purchase helper. Converts a flat annual rate into the monthly discountRate (% per MONTH; pass it straight to create_lease) and returns instalment, finalInstalment, totalInterest and totalPayable.

tools.name: bulk_update_leases
tools.description: Bulk update leases (max 500) for renaming or activating drafts, not for rent changes. Each row is a partial update and needs resourceId and reference. A resourceId may appear once. No tags: use update_lease. Admin only for active rows. Async: returns the final job if it finished, else a jobId → poll search_background_jobs by resourceId. If the result says it runs in the background, do not poll: its result arrives by itself. PARTIAL_SUCCESS: errorDetails. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_fixed_asset_totals
tools.description: Asset register totals as at a date: purchase amount, accumulated depreciation, net book value.

tools.name: get_fixed_asset_disposal_totals
tools.description: Disposed (sold or discarded) asset totals as at a date: book value, sale proceeds, gain/loss. Positive = loss.

tools.name: get_fixed_asset_schedule
tools.description: One asset's depreciation schedule by month and year with book value, plus disposal rows once disposed. At most 60 months per call (totalPeriods): pass fromPeriod/toPeriod for the months asked about (row 1 is period 1).

tools.name: preview_fixed_asset_custom_schedule
tools.description: Check a custom depreciation schedule and get its month-by-month timeline. Saves nothing. Save it (create or update with CUSTOM_SCHEDULE) only when status is FULLY_SCHEDULED with no errors. defaultSchedule is the straight-line split. At most 60 periods per call: see totalPeriods, page with fromPeriod/toPeriod.

tools.name: calculate_fixed_asset_disposal
tools.description: Accumulated depreciation up to the month of depreciationEndDate, plus any brought in, before you sell or discard an asset. Saves nothing but needs the Admin role. Net book value = purchase amount minus totalAccumulateDepreciationAtDisposal; gain or loss on a sale = sale amount minus net book value (negative is a loss; get_fixed_asset_disposal_totals reports loss as positive).

tools.name: search_fixed_asset_eligible_lines
tools.description: Search unclaimed bill and journal lines on Fixed Asset accounts, grouped by document then account; limit counts documents, not lines. To register one: sourceLineResourceId is purchaseBusinessTransactionResourceId, documentType is purchaseBusinessTransactionType, amount is purchaseAmount.

tools.name: search_fixed_asset_types
tools.description: Search asset types. Pick a typeCode whose categoryCode matches the asset category.

tools.name: search_deferrals
tools.description: Search deferrals (prepaid expenses and deferred revenue) with figures as at endDate: deferralAmount, amortizedAmount, remainingAmount. Find by reference or name.

tools.name: get_deferral
tools.description: Get one deferral: status, viewStatus, category, deferralAmount, amortizedAmount, remainingAmount, schedule settings, accounts and the source lines.

tools.name: create_deferral
tools.description: Create a deferral that spreads whole bill, invoice or journal lines over months; several: bulk_upsert_deferrals. saveAsDraft defaults to TRUE and a draft posts nothing: pass false to post, then check status before saying it is booked.

tools.name: update_deferral
tools.description: Update one deferral or activate a draft (isDraftToActive: true); 2 or more: one bulk_update_deferrals call. Partial: send only what changes; text, tags and lists cannot be cleared. Changing schedule fields (lines, start, months, account, method) on an ACTIVE deferral deletes and re-posts every row and is refused once a period is locked. CLOSED_OUT must be reopened first. Never send a get_deferral result back. Activating or changing an ACTIVE deferral: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_deferral
tools.description: Delete a DRAFT deferral, freeing its source lines and reference. Any other status is not deleted by the agent: the user does it in Jaz. To stop releasing partway and keep history, use close_out_deferral instead. Confirm first: say what it changes and wait for a yes. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: close_out_deferral
tools.description: Stop releasing after closeOutDate (used as given, any day, not moved to month-end). Posts NOTHING for the remaining balance: it stays on the deferral account (balance sheet) until a journal clears it, so offer a write-off or refund journal. ACTIVE only; reverse with reopen_deferral. Use this, not delete, when a subscription is cancelled. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: reopen_deferral
tools.description: Reopen a CLOSED_OUT deferral: the stored schedule after the close-out date is posted again and it returns to ACTIVE. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_deferral_totals
tools.description: Register totals as at a date: deferralAmount, amortizedAmount, remainingAmount for ACTIVE and CLOSED_OUT deferrals. ALWAYS pass category, once per category: without it prepaid assets and deferred revenue liabilities add into one meaningless number.

tools.name: get_deferral_schedule
tools.description: One deferral's release rows by year: valueDate, amount released, remaining value. Rows come from posted ledger rows, so a draft returns none. A closed-out deferral has a final CLOSED_OUT row. At most 60 rows per call (totalPeriods): pass fromPeriod/toPeriod for the periods asked about (row 1 is period 1).

tools.name: search_deferral_eligible_lines
tools.description: Search unclaimed bill, invoice and journal lines on deferral accounts, grouped by document then account; limit counts documents, not lines. Empty until an account is marked as a deferral account. A line with draftDeferralReference is already held by that draft. amount is net of tax: the figure the deferral is built from.

tools.name: search_deferral_types
tools.description: Search deferral types. Pick a typeCode and always filter by categoryCode: the same typeCode exists in both categories.

tools.name: search_deferral_accounts
tools.description: Search the accounts marked as deferral accounts (Current Asset gives PREPAID_EXPENSE, Current Liability gives DEFERRED_REVENUE). Reconciliation reports take these accountResourceIds.

tools.name: mark_deferral_accounts
tools.description: Mark (deferralAccount: true) or unmark chart-of-accounts entries as deferral accounts. This changes org setup: confirm with the user first. Only active, non-control Current Asset (prepaid) or Current Liability (deferred revenue) accounts; the source line must already be coded to that account. Unmarking an account any deferral uses (drafts included) is refused. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: preview_deferral_custom_schedule
tools.description: Check uneven release ranges without saving. deferralAmount is the sum of the eligible line amounts. Save with create_deferral only when status is FULLY_SCHEDULED with no errors (others: SHORT, OVER, INCOMPLETE). Periods are anniversary periods from the start date, not calendar months. At most 60 periods per call: see totalPeriods, page with fromPeriod/toPeriod.

tools.name: search_loans
tools.description: Search loans (borrowings: term loans and director, shareholder, related-party or intercompany accounts). Each row carries outstandingPrincipal, currentPortion, nextDueDate and nextDueAmount as at endDate (default today). No free-text query: use the named filters, then get_loan.

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: Get a loan with its terms, accounts and figures as of today: outstandingPrincipal, accruedInterest, currentPortion, nonCurrentPortion, nextDueDate. Schedule: get_loan_schedule; changes: list_loan_events.

tools.name: create_loan
tools.description: Record a borrowing after preview_loan_schedule; several: bulk_upsert_loans. The register books interest every month-end and the current/non-current split. It never posts cash: the user records the drawdown receipt and EVERY installment IN FULL themselves, to the accounts named in the params.

tools.name: update_loan
tools.description: Update one loan or activate a draft (isDraftToActive: true); 2 or more: one bulk_update_loans call. Partial: send only what changes; a field cannot be cleared. reference is kept. CLOSED_OUT and ENDED loans refuse edits. On an ACTIVE loan a term, fee or account change rewrites the whole schedule from the start (refused when a month is locked): for a mid-life change use a loan event (rate: change_loan_rate). Activating or changing an ACTIVE loan: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_loan
tools.description: Delete a DRAFT loan with its schedule, fees and events. Any other status is not deleted by the agent: the user does it in Jaz. To stop posting but keep the loan, use close_out_loan. Irreversible. Confirm first: say what it changes and wait for a yes. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: close_out_loan
tools.description: Stop posting a loan from the month-end of closeOutDate; balances stay and the loan stays on the register. Not an exit: to end a loan use settle_loan, refinance_loan, forgive_loan or convert_loan_to_shares. ACTIVE loans only, and a term loan only before its end date. After close out and reopen, earlier events can never be undone, so undo any you need first. Reverse with reopen_loan. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: reopen_loan
tools.description: Reopen a CLOSED_OUT loan: rows are rebuilt from its terms and events and it returns to ACTIVE. Events recorded before the close out can no longer be undone afterwards. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: get_loan_totals
tools.description: What the business owes in total at a date: outstandingPrincipal, currentPortion, nonCurrentPortion, accruedInterest across loans on the books (drafts left out, ended loans 0).

tools.name: get_loan_schedule
tools.description: One loan's repayment schedule: per installment dueDate, installment, interest, principal, closingBalance, currentPortion, status (SCHEDULED or SKIPPED), posted. Term loans only: a draft or on-demand loan has no rows. At most 60 installments per call (totalPeriods): pass fromPeriod/toPeriod (periodNumber) for the installments asked about.

tools.name: list_loan_events
tools.description: A loan's events, latest first: eventType, effectiveDate, details and canUndo. Read it before undo_loan_event (only the latest event can be undone) and before retrying an event, since a retry within 2 minutes returns LOAN_EVENT_DUPLICATE (the first call committed).

tools.name: get_loan_ledger
tools.description: On-demand loans only (term loans return LOAN_NOT_ON_DEMAND): who drew and repaid what on the loan account, latest first, with balance, totalAdvances, totalRepayments and the balance per contact. A negative balance reads owedToYou. Amount above 0 is an advance owed by the company.

tools.name: search_loan_types
tools.description: Search loan types ("Loan Category"). DIRECTOR, SHAREHOLDER, RELATED_PARTY and INTERCOMPANY feed the related-party report.

tools.name: preview_loan_schedule
tools.description: The repayment schedule these terms would produce, with installmentAmount, totalInterest, totalPayments, effectiveRate, endDate and nonCurrentAccountRequired. Saves nothing. Use it before create_loan. No accounts needed. At most 60 installments per call: see totalPeriods, page with fromPeriod/toPeriod.

tools.name: bulk_upsert_loans
tools.description: Bulk CREATE loans (max 500), each ACTIVE as create_loan with saveAsDraft false. Creates only: an existing reference fails LOAN_DUPLICATE_REFERENCE and is never updated. No CUSTOM shape, fees, capitalization, tags or gain/loss accounts: add those with update_loan afterwards. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Admin only. Async: returns the final job if it finished, else a jobId → poll search_background_jobs by resourceId. If the result says it runs in the background, do not poll: its result arrives by itself. PARTIAL_SUCCESS: errorDetails. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: bulk_update_loans
tools.description: Bulk update loans (max 500): update_loan per row, in order, same rules. Each row is partial (omitted fields keep the stored value); fees REPLACE the stored list; an ACTIVE loan's term change rewrites its schedule. No tags (rows with tags are refused: use update_loan, which keeps tags you do not name), attachments or custom fields. A resourceId may appear once. reference is required on every row. Admin only for active rows. Async: returns the final job if it finished, else a jobId → poll search_background_jobs by resourceId. If the result says it runs in the background, do not poll: its result arrives by itself. PARTIAL_SUCCESS: errorDetails. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: record_loan_drawdown
tools.description: Raise the principal of a loan on a date (a second tranche) and rebuild the schedule. Term loans, not CUSTOM-schedule. An on-demand advance is just the user's bank entry. The user records Dr Bank / Cr Non-current Loan; the register posts no cash. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: prepay_loan
tools.description: Reduce principal on a date with an extra repayment and rebuild the schedule. keep says what stays: the same installment (term shortens) or the same term (installments fall). Term loans, not CUSTOM-schedule. The user records the cash and any penalty. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: change_loan_rate
tools.description: The lender changed the interest rate from a date. Use this, never update_loan, for a rate change: an update rewrites history and fails once a month is locked. Term loans, not CUSTOM-schedule. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: capitalize_loan_interest
tools.description: The lender added one installment's whole interest to the principal. Later installments are recalculated over the same term. Term loans, not CUSTOM-schedule. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: record_loan_payment_holiday
tools.description: Skip installments (a payment holiday). The skipped interest is added to the balance in both treatments. Read the periodNumbers from get_loan_schedule first. Term loans, not CUSTOM-schedule. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: restructure_loan
tools.description: New terms from an installment due date, with the 10% test: under 10% the loan continues with a catch-up posted (needs a gain/loss account and the unamortized costs account on the loan: set the latter with update_loan first); 10% or more ends the loan and creates a NEW one (its id is in the event details, reference <old>-R). Send at least one of annualInterestRate, loanTerm, installmentOverride, fees. Sign: gainLossAmount above 0 is a gain. Term loans, not CUSTOM-schedule. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: settle_loan
tools.description: End a loan early (payoff). The preview shows the payoff (totalAmount = principal + interest + settlement fees + penalty). Recording ends the loan SETTLED, writes off fees not yet amortized and posts no payoff entry: the user records Dr Current Loan / Cr Bank. A term loan cannot be settled on its final due date. On-demand: the user records the repayment first so the ledger reads exactly 0 on the date (LOAN_PAYOFF_NOT_RECORDED); money owed to the company is refused (LOAN_NOTHING_OWED). Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: forgive_loan
tools.description: Write off the whole loan: the lender forgave it (gain to profit and loss) or a shareholder forgave it (capital contribution). Term or on-demand (on-demand uses the ledger balance; nothing owed at 0 or below is refused, LOAN_NOTHING_OWED). amount must equal the outstanding principal; interest to date is written off too. Ends the loan SETTLED. Sign: gainLossAmount above 0 is a gain. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: convert_loan_to_shares
tools.description: Convert the whole loan (term or on-demand) into shares (IFRIC 19): principal and interest to date are cleared against share capital at fairValue; the difference goes to gain or loss (above 0 is a gain). Ends the loan SETTLED. Preview first (preview: true saves nothing), then record. Recording: Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: refinance_loan
tools.description: Settle the old TERM loan on refinanceDate and create a new ACTIVE loan from newLoan. Returns the NEW loan. Preview the payoff with settle_loan (preview: true) and the new terms with preview_loan_schedule. The user records the cash. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: reclassify_loan_as_current
tools.description: Make the whole TERM loan balance current from the first month-end on or after the date (IAS 1.74): use for a covenant breach. waiverDate, when the bank waived it, returns the split to schedule. A waiver cannot be added later: undo the event and record it again with waiverDate. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: undo_loan_event
tools.description: Reverse the latest event on a loan and rebuild from the day before it. Find it with list_loan_events (canUndo), then undo it. Only the latest event can be undone; ACTIVATE, CLOSE_OUT and REOPEN cannot. If the user names an older event, list the later ones and ask before undoing them, newest first. A replacement loan from refinance or a 10%+ restructure is deleted with it while it has no later event. Admin only. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: calculate_loan_opening_balance
tools.description: Suggest an openingBalance for a loan event after a missed, late or partial payment: scheduleBalance (assumes on-time payment), ledgerBalance (what the user posted on the loan accounts) and suggestedBalance. Saves nothing. TERM loans only. Pass the figure the user confirms as openingBalance on the event.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions. Returns status, interval, next schedule date, amount, transaction type.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: Get full subscription details including line items, schedule, and payment history.

tools.name: create_subscription
tools.description: Subscription: auto-generates invoices on schedule WITH proration. DIFFERENT from scheduled_invoice: subscriptions prorate partial periods (credit notes for mid-period changes), but currency/tax/account are immutable after creation. Use for software licenses, retainers, recurring SaaS. Invoices only (no bills).

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Update a subscription (interval, end date, status, template, proratedConfig). `data` is required on every update, even end-date-only: create shape (reference, valueDate, dueDate, contactResourceId, lineItems with accountResourceId), not get_subscription's `data`. Omitted status is kept. Line accounts and tax profiles are immutable: cancel and recreate. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: delete_subscription
tools.description: Delete a subscription. Removes the recurring schedule. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel an active subscription. Prorates remaining period and stops future billing. Safe to call; subscriptions can be reactivated after cancellation. Always use this tool when the user asks to cancel a subscription. Must cancel before delete. If this action involved a judgment call, record it (jot field or jot tool).

tools.name: search_scheduled_transactions
tools.description: Search scheduled transactions (subscriptions / recurring invoices / journals / cash entries).

tools.name: generate_vat_ledger
tools.description: Generate VAT/GST ledger report showing all tax transactions for the period.

tools.name: generate_equity_movement
tools.description: Generate equity movement report (statement of changes in equity).

tools.name: generate_bank_balance_summary
tools.description: Generate bank balance summary report: snapshot of all bank account balances at a point in time.

tools.name: generate_bank_reconciliation_summary
tools.description: Generate bank reconciliation summary for a specific bank account. Essential for month-end close; call this for each in-scope bank account for the current entity and reporting period. Use for bank recon status, unreconciled items count, or reconciliation summaries.

tools.name: generate_bank_reconciliation_details
tools.description: Generate detailed bank reconciliation report showing matched/unmatched items.

tools.name: generate_fixed_assets_summary
tools.description: Generate fixed assets summary report grouped by account, type, category, or status.

tools.name: generate_fixed_assets_reconciliation_summary
tools.description: Generate fixed assets reconciliation summary: reconciles asset register with general ledger.

tools.name: generate_deferrals_summary
tools.description: Generate the deferrals roll-forward for a period: deferral amount, opening remaining, amortized in period, closing remaining. Sections never mix categories (prepaid vs deferred revenue).

tools.name: generate_deferrals_reconciliation_summary
tools.description: Generate the deferrals reconciliation: does the deferral register agree with the general ledger, per deferral account and per category. A difference usually means a line on the account not yet deferred.

tools.name: generate_leases_summary
tools.description: Generate the lease register (the IFRS 16 lease note) for a period: opening liability, additions, interest, payments, terminations, closing, current and non-current, right-of-use asset, grouped by type, status or account. The maturity analysis is a sheet of the download_export leases-register file.

tools.name: generate_leases_reconciliation_summary
tools.description: Reconcile the lease register to the general ledger per lease account, counting scheduled rent as debits to the current lease liability. A liability difference almost always means a rent bill coded elsewhere, posted in another month, or not booked.

tools.name: generate_loans_summary
tools.description: Borrowings note: per loan opening balance, drawdowns, repayments, interest, closing balance, current and non-current portion and accrued interest, grouped by type, status, account or lender. Positions are the register's; movements read the ledger, so an unrecorded repayment shows here.

tools.name: generate_loans_roll_forward
tools.description: Loan roll-forward over a period: opening + drawdowns + repayments + interest + fees + non-cash = closing, tying to the balance sheet. Drawdowns and repayments are the user's own postings, so a missing repayment shows as a gap.

tools.name: generate_loans_related_party
tools.description: Related-party loan balances by contact: loans of type DIRECTOR, SHAREHOLDER, RELATED_PARTY and INTERCOMPANY, for the audit.

tools.name: generate_loans_interest
tools.description: Interest cost per loan for the period: interest, interest added to principal, interest to an asset, fees amortized and total finance cost.

tools.name: generate_loans_maturity_analysis
tools.description: Liquidity note as at the end date: per term loan the undiscounted installments still due within one year, one to two, two to five and over five years, plus future interest and principal outstanding. On-demand balances fall within one year.

tools.name: generate_loans_reconciliation_summary
tools.description: Loan register vs general ledger per account, in two groups: loan liability accounts and unamortized transaction cost accounts. The register side includes what the user is expected to post, so a non-zero difference means a missed, late, partial or mis-coded installment: name the account and amount and check that month. Debit minus credit, so liabilities read negative.

tools.name: generate_aged_receivables_summary
tools.description: Aged Receivables Summary as at endDate: the summary report the dashboard shows under that name. For credit control, collections and customer payment follow-up; for the breakdown per customer, use generate_aged_receivables.

tools.name: generate_aged_payables_summary
tools.description: Aged Payables Summary as at endDate: the summary report the dashboard shows under that name. For payment runs and supplier follow-up; for the breakdown per supplier, use generate_aged_payables.

tools.name: get_ledger_highlights
tools.description: Get ledger highlights, summary metadata about the org general ledger: transaction counts by type, date range, active accounts, active currencies, and cross-currency detection. No parameters needed.

tools.name: list_contact_groups

tools.name: get_contact_group

tools.name: search_contact_groups

tools.name: delete_contact_group

tools.description: Get a custom field by resourceId. Returns full definition including appliesTo flags and list options.

tools.name: search_custom_fields
